items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: He's the first one I started in elementary.

ctx.x: Did he give lessons to other people or you say he didn't have any patience for you? What? Did your father have any other pupils? Did he give any lessons to other people?
Yeah, he had pupils. He had pupils. He had pupils. Looked like he had. But not for you. Yeah. Yeah. Mm-hm.

One of my scholars is going to graduate at college. He's graduating music. How do you call his son? Oscar Ruzon. Ruzon. That's right. Ruzon's son. He's one of your scholars? Yeah. He's the first one I started in elementary. Did you teach mostly clarinet or sax? No, I started teaching clarinet. Yeah. And he's going to graduate in music. He's going to graduate in music sometime this June, I believe.
